sourceDetail: Cabin geometry (number, deck, absolute x/y centroid, fill colour) parsed from deckmaps.com versioned deck SVGs (/data/out/celebrity/celebrity-edge/v2448/deck-<N>.<hash>.svg), one .cabinShape element (path/polygon/rect) carrying data-cabin per stateroom. Path centroids computed by fully resolving relative SVG path commands to absolute points. Category legend built by matching each fill colour to a Celebrity stateroom category using representative-cabin category tags scraped from cruisedeckplans.com (Celebrity Edge deck-by-deck and category-detail pages), cross-checked against per-deck geometry (inboard=Interior, outer hull=veranda/ocean-view, outermost aft=suites) and against category counts.

notes.completeness: FULL grid of every numbered stateroom deckmaps encodes for Celebrity Edge: decks 3,6,7,8,9,10,11,12 plus the 6 two-story Edge Villas. 1461 unique stateroom numbers. deckmaps' raw cabinShape count is 1467, which matches Celebrity's advertised ~1,467 staterooms exactly; the 6-cabin difference is the 6 Edge Villas (15100-15106), which are two-story and drawn on BOTH the deck-15 and deck-16 plans in the source. They are counted ONCE here and recorded on deck 15 (matching their 15xxx numbering); physically they span decks 15-16. Decks 2,4,5,14 carry no staterooms in the source (dining/pool/spa/public); decks 15,16 carry only the villas.
notes.category: deckmaps encodes category only via cabin fill colour. 31 distinct fills map to 15 Celebrity Edge categories (most categories use several colour shades for sub-blocks / service tiers). See colorLegend. Concierge Class and AquaClass are physically Infinite-Veranda cabins sold as higher service tiers; they are reported as their sold category, not merged into Edge Infinite Veranda.
notes.section: DERIVED heuristic. Bow confirmed at the low-y end on every deck (cabin numbers increase fore->aft). section = forward/mid/aft thirds of the ship length, using a single global y-range shared by the full-length decks 6-12. Approximate; the 6 Edge Villas are hard-set to 'aft' because their deck-15/16 SVGs use a separate local coordinate system.
notes.side: DERIVED then ANCHORED. Even cabin numbers sit on the higher-x beam row, odd on the lower-x row, cleanly on every deck. Anchored to a real cabin: stateroom 6218 (even) is starboard per a first-person Celebrity Edge review, so side = starboard for even numbers, port for odd. Interior cabins straddle the centerline but still follow the even/odd split.
notes.obstructed: deckmaps SVGs carry no obstructed-view flag; obstructed=false for all (source does not encode obstruction; not an assertion of clear view). Celebrity Edge does have obstructed cabins (e.g. ~10 of the 16 Edge Singles) - a separate research layer.
